title: DeriveBSD preopened capability map for Capsicum launchers (preopen.map) (v0.1)

map_id.description: Stable id for the map (UUID recommended).

derived_from.description: Optional provenance pointers for the compiler/inputs that produced the map.

entries.description: Stable-ordered list of preopened handles (labels + targets + rights).

descriptor_set_posture.description: Optional statement that the child inherits only the reviewed descriptor set.

closefrom_posture.description: Optional statement that non-reviewed descriptors are closed before capability-mode handoff.

stdio_posture.description: Optional statement of how stdio is handled for the launched child.

environment_posture.description: Optional statement that the child process environment is reviewed/minimal rather than inherited wholesale.

environment_allowlist.description: Optional stable-ordered allowlist of environment variable names admitted into the launched child.

argv_posture.description: Optional statement that child argv is launcher-reviewed rather than media-derived.

argv_template.description: Optional reviewed argv template for the launched child.

cwd_posture.description: Optional statement that the child cwd is launcher-owned scratch rather than inherited authority.

cwd.description: Optional reviewed cwd path for the launched child.

executable_posture.description: Optional statement that the child executable is launcher-resolved, digest-pinned, and not selected through PATH/cwd/media state.

executable_locator.description: Optional reviewed locator for the executable selected by the launcher.

executable_digest.description: Optional digest of the executable selected by the launcher.

wrapper_contract_digest.description: Optional digest of the wrapper contract binding executable identity to argv/env/cwd/preopens/stdio posture.

helper_discovery_posture.description: Optional statement of whether helper/plugin discovery is disabled or explicitly wrapper-brokered.

runtime_dependency_posture.description: Optional statement that runtime dependencies are launcher-pinned rather than selected through ambient loader search.

runtime_dependency_closure_digest.description: Optional digest of the runtime dependency closure selected by the launcher.

dynamic_loader_posture.description: Optional statement that dynamic-loader path inputs such as LD_LIBRARY_PATH/cwd/media-derived paths are not authority.

credential_posture.description: Optional statement that the child worker credential envelope is launcher-fixed, unprivileged, and free of supplementary groups.

worker_user.description: Optional reviewed worker user/principal label for the launched child.

worker_group.description: Optional reviewed worker group label for the launched child.

supplementary_groups.description: Optional stable-ordered supplementary group labels admitted into the launched child; empty for the first removable-media local fallback lane.

privilege_regain_posture.description: Optional statement that setuid/setgid/saved-id or ambient privilege regain paths are unavailable to the launched child.

process_lifecycle_posture.description: Optional launcher-owned lifecycle posture for the worker process tree.

descendant_posture.description: Optional posture string for descendant/subprocess admission in this preopen map.

reap_posture.description: Optional posture string for launcher reaping before derivative receipt.

worker_exit_posture.description: Optional posture string for worker exit observation before authoritative derivative receipt.

resource_envelope_posture.description: Optional launcher-owned resource envelope posture for the worker process tree.

resource_receipt_posture.description: Optional posture string for receipt-visible resource envelope and observed usage evidence.

resource_failure_posture.description: Optional posture string for fail-closed handling when the resource envelope is exceeded.

output_bound_posture.description: Optional posture string for declared derivative output size bounds.

resource_limits.description: Optional reviewed resource envelope for the post-detach removable-media later worker.

peer_interaction_posture.description: Optional statement that the launched child is isolated from ambient peer ptrace, signal, IPC, and procfs control/observation.

peer_interaction_receipt_posture.description: Optional statement that peer-isolation and signal-control posture are receipt-visible.

signal_posture.description: Optional statement that signal/control authority for the launched child stays launcher-owned.

ipc_posture.description: Optional statement that unreviewed IPC surfaces stay out of the first lane.

procfs_posture.description: Optional statement that procfs, ptrace, and ktrace visibility are unavailable to the child and ambient peers.

ambient_input_posture.description: Optional statement that ambient host inputs are launcher-sealed rather than worker-read authority.

ambient_input_receipt_posture.description: Optional statement that the ambient-input envelope and launcher-owned timestamps are receipt-visible.

clock_posture.description: Optional statement that wall-clock, timezone, and calendar reads are not derivative authority.

randomness_posture.description: Optional statement that worker randomness or host entropy are not derivative input authority.

host_identity_posture.description: Optional statement that hostname, kernel/sysctl, locale, and machine identity are not derivative authority.

network_posture.description: Optional statement that network egress/socket/DNS/remote-callback authority is absent for the launched child.

network_receipt_posture.description: Optional statement that the no-network envelope is receipt-visible.

name_resolution_posture.description: Optional statement that DNS, mDNS, NSS, resolver, and host-name-service inputs are not derivative authority.

proxy_posture.description: Optional statement that proxy and remote-service configuration are not admitted into the launched child.

remote_dependency_posture.description: Optional statement that remote fetches, callbacks, telemetry, update checks, and remote service dependencies are not derivative authority.

persistent_state_posture.description: Optional statement that durable user-home/cache/config/history/host-state write authority is absent for the launched child.

persistent_state_receipt_posture.description: Optional statement that durable-state absence and scratch cleanup are receipt-visible.

scratch_posture.description: Optional statement that worker scratch is launcher-created, empty, per-run, bounded, and nonauthoritative.

scratch_cleanup_posture.description: Optional statement that scratch cleanup completes before derivative receipt authority.

cache_config_posture.description: Optional statement that user-home, cache, config, state, history, profile stores, and reusable TMPDIR state are not derivative authority.

contract_closure_posture.description: Optional statement that the launched child contract is schema-backed and protected by positive plus negative fixtures.

contract_digest.description: Optional digest of the reviewed post-detach contract closure object.

backend_evidence_posture.description: Optional statement that FreeBSD launch/enforcement evidence must be bound to receipts instead of asserted by prose.

negative_fixture_policy.description: Optional statement that known-bad authority shapes must fail validation before the lane is considered closed.

launch_evidence_posture.description: Optional statement that post-detach FreeBSD launch evidence is typed and red-fixture guarded.

launch_evidence_digest.description: Optional digest of the post-detach FreeBSD launch evidence object.

launch_evidence_schema.description: Optional schema path for the post-detach FreeBSD launch evidence object.

launch_evidence_negative_fixture_policy.description: Optional statement that known-bad FreeBSD launch evidence shapes must fail validation.

entry_id.description: Stable label/id for this handle (e.g., cfg_ro, state_rw, logs_append).

path.description: Path for dir/file/unix_socket entries (path resolution happens before cap_enter).

rights.description: Capsicum rights mask labels (treated as stable strings; the launcher lowers to cap_rights_t).

intent.description: Optional human hint (why this handle exists).

risk_tags.description: Optional coarse tags for UIs (does not replace diff/gates).
